reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: I have been using HARNA for about 6 months now and I have come to love it. I began with a program of just Asian Pilates,  which I loved because it wasn’t high impact or impossible and the workouts were only about 15 minutes long. After a couple months I started exploring the app more and I realized they had so many options and styles of workout videos! I’ve incorporated yoga, regular Pilates, etc to mix it up some and they have worked with me on price so that I could afford to continue using the app. I simply love HARNA! I look and feel great at 47 years of age and I can’t recommend it enough!

reviews.title: I am really disappointed their service
reviews.text:
My experience did not match my expectations. During the sign-up process, I was repeatedly directed to payment pages and found it difficult to navigate away or cancel. As a result, my account was charged twice, despite my intention to make only a single purchase.

Once I realized what had happened, I immediately stopped using the service and requested a refund. Unfortunately, despite my request, I have not received my money back. I have also attempted to contact your support team several times but have not received a response.

The lack of communication and the delay in resolving this matter have been extremely frustrating. I expect a prompt review of my case and the immediate processing of my refund.
